title: GROUPBY aggregates each group with an iterator over CURRENTGROUP
query: EVALUATE GROUPBY ( Sales, Product[Color], "Qty", SUMX ( CURRENTGROUP (), Sales[Quantity] ) )

source.quote: CURRENTGROUP returns a set of rows from the table argument of GROUPBY that belong to the current row of the GROUPBY result.
source.supports: the iterator runs over the rows of the group

source.quote: Start with the specified table (and all related tables in the "to-one" direction).
source.supports: a related column can be the group-by column

derivation: Sales rows by product colour (Bike and Helmet are Red, Lock is Blue, Scooter is Green): rows 1, 2, 3, 5, 7 are Red, rows 4, 6 are Blue, none is Green. Red quantity: 1 + 2 + 1 + 2 + 1 = 7. Blue: 5 + 3 = 8. Green has no Sales rows, so no group.
